audit.why: Sona is immobile with no self-peel early, so the hook wins levels 1-5, but her Accelerando-fed Crescendo and aura items make her a stronger teamfight enabler than a single-target engage once both sides hit two items.

Spikes at level 2 (Q/Riptide all-in before her Flash is needed), level 6 (Depth Charge answers Crescendo), and first item (Q-E out-trades her poke); she takes over at 2+ items via aura stacking and a shorter ult cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit for Crescendo; missingInteractions flag Aria of Perseverance's anti-heal timing, its burst-absorbing shield, Power Chord's auto-reset combo tell, and Hymn of Valor's on-hit scaling as unaddressed. phases[6].side also still reads the generic 'Skill' placeholder even though content win[6] and the late-game prose already call the 2+ item stage for Sona.
audit.why: Real cooldown numbers make the cooldown-window advice actionable, and each missingInteractions entry is a checkable kit fact that changes play (when to force the shield out, when anti-heal matters, what the poke tell looks like, why armour alone misreads her on-hit poke). The side/why mismatch would show one verdict in the chart row and a contradicting sentence under it.
audit.corrected: Added the Crescendo cooldown, folded Power Chord's auto-reset tell into breakdown.early, Aria's shield/anti-heal into the cooldowns and itemization fields, on-hit scaling into a don't bullet, and aligned phases[6].side with the already-correct win[6]='Sona' verdict with a matching why.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Sona Crescendo (140s down to 100s at rank 3): matchup-defining — spread while it is up, it writes your spacing rules. - Aria of Perseverance's 10s-CD shield absorbs your burst window — force it out before you commit. - W Titan's Wrath is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the engage you don't use governs more than the one you do.
edits.after: Watch for Power Chord's auto-reset wind-up on her poke — that's the burst tell, not the Hymn of Valor cast. Zone with the hook threat and the engage you don't use still governs the lane.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Her Accelerando passive banks ability haste toward a faster ultimate the longer the lane runs clean — force fights before she stacks it, not after.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Hymn of Valor auto-resets and applies on-hit, so her poke scales with attack speed items — armour alone misreads that trade.
